pages.en:
Enquiries by C.D.S.214, C.D.C.160 and D.S.Turner.
At 7.30 p.m. 26-8-40 C.P.S.1119 and C.P.C.898
brought to the Station a male Chinese Tsang King
Jao(張根橋) described overleaf, who they arrested
in possession of an unlicensed pistol.
Enquiries ascertained the following. At about
7.15 p.m. 26-8-40 a uniform search in charge of
P.P.S.85 Ilenchko was operating on Yu Ya Ching Road
near Avenue Ward VII. A Route No.17 Railless Tram
travelling from South to North was stopped and
searched by the party and in the 1st class
compartment the accused man was found to be carrying
a small auto pistol. The pistol, a .32 cal. H. and
S. automatic serial No.13534, containing 5 rounds
of ammunition was wrapped in a large paper envelope.
The accused man was brought to the Station and
when questioned by detectives he stated that he had
brought the pistol from Peetung. He stated that he
was formerly employed as a policeman in Hankwei.
Since the hostilities he has been working as a
commander of a Peace Salvation Corps controlled by
the Japanese.
Recently the accused met one named Tsang Ah
Boo(張阿大) in Hankwei. This man told the accused
that his son, Tsang Kah Oung(張國珍) is employed
in 76 Josefield Road and that he could get the
accused a job if he was able to supply his own pistol
According to the accused, he decided to try
and get work at 86 Josefield Road and he was on the
way to that address when he was arrested.
pages.zh:
经刑事侦缉股警探214号、刑事侦缉股警佐160号及特纳（Turner）警探调查。
1940年8月26日晚上7时30分，中央巡捕房印籍巡长1119号及中央巡捕房华籍巡捕898号将一名华籍男子曾根桥（Tsang King Jao，張根橋）带至捕房，此人如下页所述，因持有无照手枪而被捕。
经查询查明以下情况。1940年8月26日晚上7时15分左右，由印籍巡长85号伊连科（Ilenchko）率领的制服搜查队在靠近爱多亚路七段（Avenue Ward VII）的虞洽卿路上执行任务。一辆由南向北行驶的17路无轨电车被该队拦停并搜查，在一等车厢内发现被告携带一支小型自动手枪。该手枪为.32口径哈里斯与史密斯（H. and S.）自动手枪，序列号13534，内含5发子弹，包裹在一个大纸信封中。被告被带至捕房，经侦探讯问时称，他是从浦东带来这支手枪的。他声称以前在汉口当过警察。自战事爆发以来，他一直担任由日本人控制的“和平救国军”的指挥官。
最近，被告在汉口遇到一个叫张阿大（Tsang Ah Boo，張阿大）的人。此人告诉被告，他的儿子张国珍（Tsang Kah Oung，張國珍）在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）76号任职，如果被告能自备手枪，他可以帮被告谋得一份工作。据被告称，他决定设法去极司菲尔路86号求职，他在前往该地址途中被捕。

Y.1 55.0/40.

Nan Wei St., No. 10,
Yau Ma Tei. 26-8-40.

Case No. ( ) K. 16, page 34,
C.I. 214.
translated by Lock K u Ting I

Formerly I was a tailor. Since the commencement of
the Sino-Japanese Hostilities, I became a member of a guerrilla
Unit under one named Vai Zai Kung at Po Tung. I left this
Unit until Feb. 1939. Two months later I again joined the
same Unit. I again left in July 1940. In Oct. 1940 through
my friend Yue Soong Nyi, I obtained a job as a sub-commander
at the Peace Salvation Army Headquarters, Tsong Hwa Road,
Nantao, the troops under my control camping in a village near
Wunghwa.

Owing to the fact that no financial supply could be
obtained, I had/have my troops dissolved, on 23rd or 24th, March
1940.

Since then I returned to Po Tung where I became a member
of the Self Defence Corps under Tsang Miao Kung, at Sai Ting
Maung, and that I met my old acquaintance named Tsang Ah Poo
who told me that his son Tsang Koo Sung is employed in 76
Jessfield Road and that I could get a better job there if
I was able to supply a pistol. This I agreed as I had a
pistol in my possession, which I obtained from a Greek at West
Pong Ka Sah, Sai Ting Maung, Po Tung, in May 1939.

At 3 p.m. 26-8-40 I taking my pistol left Po Tung to
Shanghai by boat. On arrival I proceeded by ricksha to
the Headquarters under Ting Sih Sai on Ling Ying Road, Nantao
where I intended to visit one named Vai Hung Sai but failed.
Whereupon I again rode in a public ricksha and proceeded to
Kim Bee Racecourse P.C. from where I alighted from the ricksha
and boarded a railless tramcar with the intention to go to
pages.zh:
Y.1 55.0/40.

九龙旺角奶路臣街10号。1940年8月26日。

案件编号 ( ) K. 16，第34页，
刑事侦缉股 214号。
译者：骆古廷一（Lock K u Ting I，音译）

我从前是一名裁缝。自中日战事爆发以来，我在浦东成为魏子恭（Vai Zai Kung，音译）名下的一支游击队成员。我于1939年2月离开该部队。两个月后，我再次加入同一支部队。我于1940年7月再次离开。1940年10月，通过我的朋友岳松义（Yue Soong Nyi，音译），我在南市中华路“和平救国军”总部获得了一份副指挥官的工作，我麾下的部队驻扎在万花（Wunghwa，音译）附近的一个村庄。

由于无法获得经费供给，我于1940年3月23日或24日解散了我的部队。

此后我回到浦东，在西丁浜（Sai Ting Maung，音译）加入了曾妙恭（Tsang Miao Kung，音译）名下的自卫团，在那里我遇到了我的旧相识张阿浦（Tsang Ah Poo，音译），他告诉我他的儿子张谷生（Tsang Koo Sung，音译）在极司菲尔路76号任职，如果我能提供一支手枪，我可以在那里找到一份更好的工作。我同意了，因为我拥有一支手枪，这是我在1939年5月从浦东西丁浜西邦迦萨（West Pong Ka Sah，音译）的一名希腊人那里获得的。

1940年8月26日下午3时，我带着手枪离开浦东，乘船前往上海。抵达后，我乘黄包车前往南市灵英路（Ling Ying Road，音译）丁锡哉（Ting Sih Sai，音译）名下的总部，我打算拜访一位叫魏洪哉（Vai Hung Sai，音译）的人，但未果。于是我又乘坐公共黄包车前往跑马厅警察岗亭，在那里我下了黄包车，登上一辆无轨电车，打算去

pages.en:
to Yu Ya Ching and Nanking Road corner where I could proceed
to 70 Jessfield Road by No.2 Tramcar.
Whilst proceeding along Avenue Ed.VII near Yu Ya Ching
Road in No.17 Tramcar, I was searched and found to be in
possession of a pistol and 5 rounds of ammunition by Policemen.
True statement.

Signed Tang Ming Jao.
pages.zh:
虞洽卿路与南京路的拐角处，在那里我可以换乘2路电车前往极司菲尔路70号。
当我乘坐17路电车沿爱多亚路七段靠近虞洽卿路行驶时，我被警察搜查，发现持有一支手枪和5发子弹。
以上陈述属实。

签名：唐明乔（Tang Ming Jao）
